items.title: 53342_Cozy Cole oral history interview
items.q: Used to go on those little gigs with them sometime, play in those house parties.

ctx.x: Yeah, Corky Williams was another great pianist. Stride piano. He was there with Willie the Lion and Willie Gant, Corky Williams. Another one name of Price Jones. Dick Edwards.
I forgot to ask you yesterday when you were doing those rent parties, you were very young, did you run into Fats Waller and James P. Johnson at those?
